value.rationale: The finding removes a nontrivial cycle-consistency restriction previously presented as necessary for exact solvability of colored TASEP. It supplies a complete positive-rate parameter family, exact all-size internal currents, and a minimal transporting counterexample where irreversible microscopic circulation changes without any alteration of the equal-time spatial stationary law. This advances physical understanding of what stationary correlations can and cannot detect.
